chunks: And from him, from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl ibn Bazīʿ, who said:
I asked al-Riḍā عليه السلام about a man who has intercourse with a woman in a manner short of the private part, and the woman emits fluid. Is ghusl obligatory upon her? He said: Yes.

key_terms.الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام, the Imam being asked for the ruling
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةَ: the woman concerned in the ruling
key_terms.دُونَ الْفَرْجِ: short of the private part; without vaginal intercourse
key_terms.غُسْلٌ: ritual bath that becomes obligatory after certain states

ai.seo_question: Does ghusl become obligatory upon a woman if she emits fluid without vaginal intercourse?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that if a woman emits fluid, ghusl becomes obligatory upon her, even when intercourse did not occur in the private part. It falls within the jurisprudential discussion of ritual purity and the causes that necessitate ghusl.
